question.text: The PMS Investor Charter covers ALL the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Details of business transacted with investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Guaranteed returns are not part of the Investor Charter (or any SEBI document). The Trap: Other items (vision, business, grievance) are mandated parts. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Display the Charter prominently on the PM website and physically at offices.
